opening_rule_quote: The temporary heat shelters will remain open for people to take refuge from the heat when the Very Hot Weather Warning is in force. From 10.30pm to 8am the next day, the temporary heat shelters will also provide bedding and a sleeping place for people in need. The shelters are manned by duty attendants.
hotline_quote: For further information, please call the department's hotline before midnight on 2572 8427.
daytime_halls_quote: In addition to the above heat shelters, a number of community halls/community centres can also be used for taking refuge from the heat during their operating hours.
